learnings: When API errors occur on non-critical files (.SRCINFO, .gitignore, .editorconfig, etc.), the audit tool should not mark the entire package as inconclusive if all security-critical files (PKGBUILD, .install, patches) were successfully reviewed and found safe

The verdict aggregation logic should distinguish between 'failed to review critical files' (inconclusive) and 'failed to review non-executable metadata files' (can still return verdict based on critical files)
HTTP 400 errors from the LLM API should be retried or handled gracefully rather than immediately marking files as inconclusive
